name: Gem of Seeing
description: A clear gem cut with many facets, through which everything looks as it is.
body:
## What it does

It holds three charges and regains 1d3 each dawn. Spend one, as an action, and for 10 minutes, looking through it, you see things as they truly are out to 120 feet.

features.name: True Sight
features.text: Spend a charge: for 10 minutes you have truesight out to 120 feet while you look through the gem.
